variables.name: periodUid
variables.comment: * The UID of the period, or {@code null} if the timeline is {@link Timeline#isEmpty() empty}.

If {@link #adGroupIndex} is {@link C#INDEX_UNSET}, this is the same as {@link * #positionMs}.

variables.comment:
* The index of the ad within the ad group if the playback position is within an ad, {@link
     * C#INDEX_UNSET} otherwise.
